title: 204 No Content - HTTP | MDN - MDN Web Docs
snippet: Jun 22, 2026 · The HTTP 204 No Content successful response status code indicates that a request has succeeded, but the client doesn't need to navigate away from its current page. A 204 response is cacheable by default, and an ETag header is included in such cases.

title: odata - Is it valid to return a body along with an Http 204 ...
snippet: Feb 23, 2012 · The 204 response to PUT is not a mandatory requirement for OData servers (note that the odata.org is not a normative reference, the MS-OData document is). You can return 200 with body, in which case the body you return should be a serialization of the updated entity (after the updates were applied by the server).

snippet: Jul 27, 2026 · A 204 response should not include a message body at all. 204 Is Not "200 With Nothing in It" This is the distinction that gets lost, and it's the single most common mix-up around this code — as our own 204 reference page puts it: Some developers use 200 with an empty body instead of 204.

title: web - HTTP status codes : 204 OR 200 with body containing an ...
snippet: The RFC2616 says : 10.2.5 204 No Content The server has fulfilled the request but does not need to return an entity-body, and might want to return updated metainformation. The response MAY include new or updated metainformation in the form of entity-headers, which if present SHOULD be associated with the requested variant.
